page.layout: One column of running text. Running head at top right, page number at top right. Marginal marks down the right margin, with a few more small marks at the left edge (edge of the page, not text). Heading centred mid-page. Gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Et Xenophon suâ etiam ætate sollici-tam quàm maximè civitatem habuisse testatur. Nam cum Thebani & eorum socii infestis armis urbem Spartam premerent clade Leuctricâ viris jam ante exhaustam, visum primoribus civitatis, ait Xenophon, publicâ voce Helotibus denunciare, si qui eorum arma capere contra hostes, & in ordinibus consistere vellent, fide publicâ iis promitti libertatem: ad quam vocem cum plures quàm sexies mille nomina professi essent, & ordinibus sese miscuissent, ob multitudinem nimiam consternata civitas fuit: sed copiarum aliarum amicarum adventu motus ille rursum concidit. Sic ille. De Partheniis bello Messenio primo ex promiscuo juvenum [illegible, ~2 letters]virginum Lacænarum concubitu natis, [illegible, ~2 letters]& à reliquis Laconibus ob probrosos natales contemptui habitis, quia ultra [illegible, ~2 letters]unam ætatem Spartæ non durarunt non libuit quicquam dicere superius, nec heic libet. Fuse de his Iustinus ex Trogo libro iii, & Strabo libro vi.
main_text.head: Iudicia Spartæ.
main_text.p: Iudicia hoc modo Spartæ habuêre. [illegible, ~2 letters]Primis temporibus post Lycurgum raræ erant lites de rebus privatis, quia pecunia de quâ litigaretur, nulla e[?]

page.notes: Right margin marks are short printed symbols (apparently "S" and small signs), not legible words; shown as illegible. Left-edge marks (&, ic, ui, etc.) belong to the page edge or show-through and are not transcribed. The last line may continue on the next page ("nulla e" appears to be the start of "nullae"). Line-end hyphen in "sollici-tam" and "nulla e" as printed; "iii" and "vi" read as lowercase Roman numerals.
